status: OPEN physical realization obligations for the rank-22 residual type. The accounting target (retained ledger, whole-bank volume, exact paid moment, kappa) is certified by verify.py; the items below are exactly what a physical banked-word construction must additionally supply, in one-to-one correspondence with what the gauge-family absorption supplied in PR205/PR207's pack-pr200.py (BANK-PROOF-PR200.md).
why_new_type: The current bank construction absorbs exactly one family: the 2,200 selected entrance-gauge exteriors (ledger rank 60, hist[3*dim] per gauge). The rank-22 bin is not an exterior/completion family: per inputs/absorbed-occurrences.json it is 1,320 physical-chain frame jumps + 24 copied-centre children + 880 source-chain frame jumps per vertex. Non-gauge chains already bank their residual projectors (24-coordinate blocks) and keep every increment child, so the published mechanism does not absorb these. This is the 'future genuinely different residual type' reserved in PR207's CROSSOVERS and priced by PR208's rung ladder.

obligations.name: residual-type definition and bank blocks
obligations.statement: Define the rank-22 residual item (one per enumerated occurrence: the frame-jump residual at each chain transition listed in inputs/absorbed-occurrences.json) and its coordinate-block shape in a bank of width 72, together with the normalizer sending each item's true residual projector to its assigned block. Candidate tilings with the word's residual families are enumerated by schedule.py (block sizes 4/24/22 tiling 72); one must be selected and the per-occurrence assignment (item -> bank, offset) generated and hashed.
obligations.reference_precedent: PR205 packing.py: 'For each role, the inherited fixed normalizer sends its true residual projector to its assigned block'; BANK-PROOF-PR200.md block allocation with 9-edge-colouring of 462,078 role-copy uses.

obligations.name: formal columns of the modified word
obligations.statement: Re-run the complete formal-column checks on the modified word: every source, target and dirty-register column over F2 and over the defining integers (residual bound and packed digits as in PR200's terminal-modified replay), with the rank-22 transitions realized by bank re-assignment instead of paid children. The F2 identity and the defining-integer decoder must both hold.
obligations.reference_precedent: PR200 paired-cube-diagonal-bit-168 verify.py: 'all formal source/target/dirty columns, complete target chronology... F2 identity and its defining integer decoder'.

obligations.name: charts, routing and prime witnesses
obligations.statement: Exact charts (integer kernel bases with fraction-free inverses and replayed elementary factors) for every new block frame, the incidence colouring of the new bank incidences, and distinct integer Gram/prime witnesses for every frame the new blocks use, with residual factors below the retained q bound.
obligations.reference_precedent: PR205 packing.py chart digest and colouring checks; 'All 24,401 used bit frame IDs... distinct integer Gram witnesses'.

obligations.name: moment envelope parity
obligations.statement: Confirm that the paid moment envelope for the modified word is exactly the one arithmetic.py prices: retained child histogram as in schedule.py, stock 50,286 (three-copy normalization), deficit 5,808, worst-case bad fraction 1e-16 and fallback 32*72^2 per retained child, strict adapter and internally borrowed-row tolls paid. Any additional completion child introduced by R1 must be added to the ledger and the kappa recomputed.
obligations.reference_precedent: BANK-PROOF-PR200.md 'Fully charged child inventory and exact price'; PR205 arithmetic.py paid() wrapper.

claim_scope: verify.py certifies: enumeration provenance, whole-bank volume condition, retained ledger and row identity, both interval moment engines, three-level ordinary composition, the 47-constraint balanced assembly and the exclusion of the adjacent kappa grid point. The resulting kappa is conditional on R1-R4 exactly as every published witness in this repository is conditional on its stated finite bridge and all-size interfaces; it is not a completed finite witness until R1-R4 verify, and it is not an unconditional multiplication theorem in any case.
